name: MNHLDG
recent: MN Holdings 于2026年10月获得一份价值 RM293.88 million 的数据中心基础设施合约，并有多项凭单转换及董事交易申报。公司将于2026年12月24日召开第六届常年股东大会。
notable: 获得价值 RM293.88 million 的数据中心基础设施合约。
将于2026年12月24日召开第六届常年股东大会。
risks: 董事及主要股东在近期有多项持股变动及交易申报。
凭单转换导致新股发行，已发行股本有所增加。
earnings: 2026财年（截至6月30日）营收为 RM211.47 million，同比增长17.9%，环比增长5.7%；净利为 RM23.98 million，同比增长98.8%，环比增长12.1%；净利率为11.3%，高于上一期的10.7%。

recent_en: MN Holdings secured a RM293.88 million data centre infrastructure contract in October 2026, alongside multiple warrant conversion and director dealing announcements.
notable_en: Secured a RM293.88 million data centre infrastructure contract.
Proposed renewal of shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions and proposed authority to purchase up to 10% of its own shares.
risks_en: Several recent changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests and dealing announcements.
Warrant conversions have resulted in the issuance of new shares, increasing the issued share capital.
earnings_en: For FY2026 (ended 30 June), revenue was RM211.47 million, up 17.9% YoY and 5.7% QoQ; net income was RM23.98 million, up 98.8% YoY and 12.1% QoQ; net margin was 11.3%, higher than 10.7% previously.
